correctness.rationale: The exact two-state substochastic avoidance chain gives h_s=e_s^T Q^t 1; its eigenvalue derivatives are -(1+b/a)/(a+2b-1) and -1/(a+2b-1). The spectral error O(a^-2) times O(a log a) is o(1); all mixed factorial moments converge to products of Poisson moments. Moment determinacy, lattice tightness, and the zero-omissions event prove the TV and cover CDF claims. The Lambert specialization follows from w e^w=log a and w^2/log a ->0. The extracted standalone script checks 1,087 finite exact/symbolic/numerical assertions, complementary to the proof.
